ladder.label: DOWNTREND
ladder.why: Failed cycle — price broke below the low that started this cycle, which historically means the larger trend is rolling over (~80% of cases). Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Stand aside until a new daily cycle low forms and confirms.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 35 · failed · daily cycle broke its start low 70d ago).
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds

Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: Downtrend — stand aside until a new cycle low forms and confirms.
entry.text_zh: 下跌趋势——观望，直至新的周期低点形成并确认。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 84 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: overdue — past the typical window, so a low could form any day
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 84 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 逾期——已超过典型窗口，低点随时可能形成
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 35 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 35 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点，历史上这通常意味着更大的趋势正在掉头向下（约 80% 的情形）。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 观望，直至新的日线周期低点形成并确认。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量开始上翘；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）；投资者周期已逾期；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 35 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期于 70 天前跌破其起始低点）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：下跌趋势。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
⚠ 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点（70 天前）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
日线动量刚刚向上交叉

ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ DOWNTREND signal triggered 2 trading days ago (~2026-06-10), switching from COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE. Signal strength: strong (score -90/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 下跌趋势信号于 2 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-10），自逆势反弹切换而来。 信号强度：强（评分 -90/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: minimal no clean setup (-10)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：微弱无明确形态（-10）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: Boston Scientific Corporation (BSC) is an American biotechnology and biomedical engineering firm and multinational manufacturer of medical devices used in interventional medical specialties, including interventional radiology, interventional cardiology, peripheral interventions, neuromodulation, neurovascular intervent
profile.description_zh: 波士顿科学公司是一家美国生物技术和生物医学工程公司，也是跨国医疗设备制造商，产品用于介入医学专科，包括介入放射学、介入心脏病学、外周介入、神经调节、神经血管介入等。
